description: Java source code for REST API resource managing interest pause periods on loans, including endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting interest pauses by loan ID or external ID.

classes.name: LoanInterestPauseApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing interest pause periods on loans, providing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause period for a specific loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: createInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause period for a loan identified by external loan ID.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPauses
methods.description: Retrieves all interest pause periods for a specific loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: retrieveInterestPausesByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves all interest pause periods for a loan identified by external loan ID.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Deletes a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: deleteInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Deletes a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by external loan ID.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Updates a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by loanId.

methods.name: updateInterestPauseByExternalId
methods.description: Updates a specific interest pause period by variation ID for a loan identified by external loan ID.
